last_week_graded.selection: Real: 9-leg NBA prop parlay (Bane/Banchero/etc, -180, bonus bet)
last_week_graded.lesson: High-probability floor props, built to hit, is the one thing that's worked.

last_week_graded.selection: Real: Argentina/Under 5.5/Yes SGP vs Cape Verde
last_week_graded.lesson: Cashing out forfeited the +30% boost and still barely broke even; better to have picked a ticket that didn't need saving.

last_week_graded.selection: Real: 10-leg NFL SGPx parlay (PIT/CIN/BAL/CHI/BUF/TEN MLs + two 2-pick SGPs, +9164)
last_week_graded.lesson: Double-digit-leg parlays are lottery tickets, not a cheat-sheet card — the odds number is the tell.

last_week_graded.selection: Real: 8-leg NCAAF moneyline parlay (Oklahoma/Texas A&M/Ball State/etc, +541)
last_week_graded.lesson: Stacking eight favorites together still multiplies down to a low combined probability; a straight bet on the best one would have been the better trade.

last_week_graded.selection: Real: NCAAF Under 47.5 (live, San Jose State vs Eastern Michigan)
last_week_graded.lesson: Lost by half a point on a live total — a reminder that in-game numbers are close calls by design, which is why the card stays pre-kickoff only.
